```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests #new for reading in JSON
import io       #new for reading in JSON
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```


```{python}
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"
response = requests.get(url)
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))
```

```{python}
# Include and execute your code here
import polars.selectors as cs

numeric_cols = df.select(cs.numeric()).columns
numeric_cols.append("num_of_delays_carrier")

cleaned_df = (df
  # Cast delays_carrier to i64
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False)
  )
  .with_columns([
    pl.when(pl.col(col) < 0)
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(col))
    .alias(col)
    for col in numeric_cols
  ])
  .with_columns(
    cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed").fill_null(cs.starts_with("minutes_delayed").median())
  )
  .with_columns(
    cs.starts_with("num_of").fill_null(cs.starts_with("num_of").mean())
  )
)

cleaned_df.head()
```

## Which delay is the worst delay?

The worst delay out of delays due to carrier, security, and late aircraft is late aircraft, with a mean proportion of 0.35. Next is carrier with a mean proportion of 0.25. Security is the least with a proportion of 0.002.

```{python}

cleaned_df = cleaned_df.with_columns(
    proportion_delays_carrier = pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total")
).with_columns(
    proportion_delays_security = pl.col("num_of_delays_security") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total")
).with_columns(
    proportion_delays_late = pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft") / pl.col("num_of_delays_total")
)

comparison = (
  cleaned_df
  .select(
    "proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"
  )
  .unpivot(
    on=["proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"],
    variable_name = "delay_reason",
    value_name="proportion"
  )
  .group_by("delay_reason")
  .agg(
    pl.col("proportion").mean().alias("mean_proportion")
  )
  .sort("mean_proportion", descending=True)
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("delay_reason").str.replace("proportion_delays_", "").alias("delay_reason")
  )
)
```

```{python}
# Chart
(
ggplot(comparison, aes("delay_reason", "mean_proportion"))
+ geom_bar(stat="identity")
+ labs(
  "Proportion of Flights Delayed by Reason",
  x="Reason",
  y="Proportion"
)
)
```

```{python}
# Table
comparison
```

## Delays per reason across each airport

Each airport follows the trend of having the highest proportion being late, the second highest being carrier, and security being very low. San Diego has the highest proportion of delays and Atlanta has the lowest proportion of the 7 airports.

```{python}

airport_comparison = (
  cleaned_df
  .select(
    "airport_code",
    "proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"
  )
  .unpivot(
    on=["proportion_delays_carrier",
    "proportion_delays_security",
    "proportion_delays_late"],
    index="airport_code",
    variable_name = "delay_reason",
    value_name="proportion"
  )
  .group_by(["airport_code", "delay_reason"])
  .agg(
    pl.col("proportion").mean().alias("mean_proportion")
  )
  .with_columns(
    pl.col("delay_reason").str.replace("proportion_delays_", "").alias("delay_reason")
  )
  .sort("mean_proportion", descending=True)
)

(
ggplot(airport_comparison, aes("airport_code", "mean_proportion", fill="delay_reason"))
+ geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge")
+ labs(
  "Delay Proportions by Airport and Reason",
  x="Airport Code",
  y="Mean Proportion",
  fill="Delay Reason"
  )
)

```
